description: Updates a Stripe price by setting passed parameter values; unspecified parameters remain unchanged. Use when you need to modify price metadata, active status, lookup key, or nickname. Note: Price amounts cannot be modified via API.

inputSchema.description: Request model for updating an existing Stripe price. Only include fields to modify; unspecified fields remain unchanged.

active.description: Whether the price can be used for new purchases. Defaults to true.
active.title: Active

anyOf.description: Configuration for customer-adjustable amounts during checkout.

enabled.description: Set true to enable custom amounts, allowing customers to specify their own unit price.
enabled.title: Enabled

maximum.description: Upper limit for customer-specified unit amount in smallest currency unit.
maximum.title: Maximum

minimum.description: Lower limit for customer-specified unit amount in smallest currency unit.
minimum.title: Minimum

preset.description: Default unit amount customers can modify during checkout.
preset.title: Preset

anyOf.title: CustomUnitAmount

custom_unit_amount.description: Enables customer-adjustable amounts during checkout for this currency.

tax_behavior.description: Tax treatment: 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'. Cannot change once set.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

items.description: Represents a pricing tier for tiered billing.

flat_amount.description: Fixed tier cost regardless of unit count in smallest currency unit.
flat_amount.title: Flat Amount

flat_amount_decimal.description: Decimal version of flat_amount in minor currency units (up to 12 decimal places).
flat_amount_decimal.title: Flat Amount Decimal

unit_amount.description: Per-unit cost for tier in smallest currency unit.
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Decimal per-unit cost (up to 12 decimal places).
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

up_to.description: Tier upper bound; use 'inf' for fallback tier.
up_to.title: Up To

items.title: PriceTier

unit_amount.description: Price in smallest currency unit (0 for free).
unit_amount.title: Unit Amount

unit_amount_decimal.description: Decimal price in smallest currency unit (max 12 decimals).
unit_amount_decimal.title: Unit Amount Decimal

currency_options.description: Per-currency pricing configuration. Keys must be ISO 4217 three-letter currency codes.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

metadata.description: Key-value pairs for storing additional information. Individual keys can be unset by posting an empty value. All keys can be unset by posting an empty value to metadata.
metadata.title: Metadata

price.description: The ID of the price to update.
price.title: Price

tax_behavior.description: Tax classification: 'inclusive', 'exclusive', or 'unspecified'. Once specified, it cannot be changed.
tax_behavior.title: Tax Behavior

transfer_lookup_key.description: When true, atomically moves lookup key from another price to this one.
transfer_lookup_key.title: Transfer Lookup Key
